name: Night Shift: 1999
source: Balance work, vampirism and socialising as you explore Kings Cross, Sydney during the last year of the millennium. Keep a lid on your darkest desires and be rewarded with a deeper understanding of what it means to live again. Or don’t — no one will stop you. You’re a vampire, after all.
translation: 在千禧年的最后一年探索悉尼国王十字区时，平衡工作、吸血鬼和社交。抑制你最黑暗的欲望，并获得对重生意味着什么的更深刻的理解。或者不做——没有人会阻止你。毕竟你是吸血鬼。
